subject: how to save the specific scores for the intercept and slope in Growth Curve Models

messages.author: d111698963f78965
messages.subject: how to save the specific scores for the intercept and slope in Growth Curve Models
parts:
Hi all,

I am really stuck in one problem. When I run latend growth curve modeling in Lavaan, the descriptive information of M, SD of the intercept and slope for the growth curve is reported.  While my analyses need the specific scores for the intercept and slope, I am wondering what code I should add to Lavaan to further get the specific scores for the intercept and slope, not just the average and variance information of the intercept and slope?

Thank you very much in advance!!! Strongly I appreciate that!
Bing

messages.author: f1530326ce101401
messages.subject: Re: how to save the specific scores for the intercept and slope in Growth Curve Models
parts:
Hi Bing

I am not 100% sure whether this is the (correct) answer to your question, but I would suggest using the lavPredict function. I added some R-code (an example) below.

library(lavaan)
model <- ' i =~ 1*t1 + 1*t2 + 1*t3 + 1*t4
s =~ 0*t1 + 1*t2 + 2*t3 + 3*t4 '
fit <- growth(model, data=Demo.growth)
summary(fit)
lavPredict(fit)

Best wishes,

Jasper Bogaert

messages.subject: Re: how to save the specific scores for the intercept and slope in Growth Curve Models
parts:
Thank you very much Jasper!!

I copied and revised some codes which are supposed to extract the specific scores for intercept and slope. unfortunately there seems a bug in the revised code. The code details are:

 "
idx_ec_linear_cm <- lavInspect(materesgood, "case.idx")
ec_linear_cm_fscores <- (lavPredict(materesgood, type="lv", method = "regression"))
for (fs in colnames(ec_linear_cm_fscores)) {
  dat[idx_ec_linear_cm, fs] <- ec_linear_cm_fscores[, fs]}"

The bug occurs on the second line. The warning messages are as follows:

ec_linear_cm_fscores <- (lavPredict(materesgood, type="lv", method = "regression"))

Error in tcrossprod(ETA2, LAMBDA) : non-conformable arguments...

How can I solve this error?  Your very helpful comments or thoughts are highly appreciated!!


Best wishes,

Bing
